defs.def: existing at the beginning of a particular period, process or activity 原来的；起初的；最早的

ex.s: “I am the last original client of Frank Lloyd Wright, still living in the home he designed for me,” Reisley said, sitting in the bright open living room of the home designed by the famous architect.
ex.t: “我是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特最后一位健在的原始客户，至今仍住在他为我设计的房子里，”Reisley坐在由这位著名建筑师设计的明亮通透的客厅里说道。

ex.s: Where can you find an original copy of the Magna Carta?
ex.t: 你在哪里能找到《大宪章》的原始副本？

ex.s: The mechanism involves a repurposed reward system originally used to develop habits important for self-care.
ex.t: 这一机制涉及一种被重新利用的奖励系统，该系统原本用于培养对自我照顾很重要的习惯。

ex.s: What she proposed didn’t seem as exciting as the original project I had applied to, but I was going to give it my all.
ex.t: 她提出的方案看起来不如我最初申请的那个项目令人兴奋，但我决定全力以赴。

ex.s: From observing his mum and from his desire to give kids better drink options, he came up with his original model for the Fun Bottle.
ex.t: 从观察他妈妈和他想给孩子们更好的饮料选择的愿望出发，他想出了Fun Bottle的原始设计模型。

ex.s: Where did Tom get the idea for the original model for the Fun Bottle?
ex.t: Tom是从哪里得到Fun Bottle原始设计模型的灵感的？

ex.s: Today, they are once again a familiar sight, playing roles that are often just as important for the community as their original purpose.
ex.t: 如今，它们再次成为一道熟悉的风景，扮演着对社区来说往往与其最初用途同样重要的角色。

ex.s: originallyD．temporarily
ex.t: B．已完成

ex.s: The 105-year-old sequoia tree serves as a local landmark, not only for its longevity but also because renowned naturalist and Sierra Club cofounder John Muir provided the original seedling.
ex.t: 105年的沙柯亚树是当地的地标，不仅因为它的长寿，而且因为著名的自然学家和塞拉俱乐部联合创始人约翰·缪尔提供了原始的幼苗。

ex.s: B achieve their original goals independently
ex.t: B 独立实现它们最初的目标

ex.s: The character of Sherlock Holmes, however,remains close in tone to the original.
ex.t: 然而，夏洛克\u00b7福尔摩斯这个角色在风格上仍然与原著很接近。

ex.s: apply to the original project againD. put his heart and soul into the lab work
ex.t: 再次申请原来的项目D. 全身心投入到实验室工作中

ex.s: The original reading was either forgotten or so totally absorbed that the new chance encounter with the text produced surprise and astonishment.
ex.t: 最初的阅读要么被遗忘了，要么被完全吸收，以至于再次偶然遇到这段文字时产生了惊讶和震撼。

ex.s: We can't appreciate these kinds of details without seeing works of art as they originally appeared-something Smith believes you can do only when you have a road map.
ex.t: 如果不把这些艺术品按最初的样子来看，我们就无法欣赏此类细节——史密斯认为，只有当你有一张“路线图”时才能做到这一点。

defs.def: new and interesting in a way that is different from anything that has existed before; able to produce new and interesting ideas 首创的；独创的；有独创性的

ex.s: That’s the local stage writing team that creates many of the Children’s Theatre of Cincinnati’s original musicals, along with the holiday family musicals at Ensemble Theatre.
ex.t: 这就是本地编剧团队，他们创作了辛辛那提儿童剧院的多部原创音乐剧，以及 Ensemble Theatre 的节日家庭音乐剧。

ex.s: My reaction to the renewed reading no longer corresponded to the original experience, and I was no longer sure that I recognized myself as the same reader.
ex.t: 我对重新阅读的反应不再与最初的体验相符，我也不再确定自己是否还是同一个读者。

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 对机器而言，这种品质不是天生的，也不是人类赋予的；它是这样一个简单事实的逻辑结果：如果机器停止运转，它就无法实现其原本的目的。

ex.s: Some are classic short stories, and some are new original works.
ex.t: 有些是经典短篇故事，有些是新的原创作品。

ex.s: This includes keeping the original environment from being touched, as well as adopting new, sustainable ways of feeding farm animals.
ex.t: 这包括防止原始环境受到影响，以及采用新的可持续喂养农场动物的方法。

defs.def: painted, written, etc. by the artist rather than copied 原作的；真迹的；非复制的

ex.s: Even bottled water, scientists found earlier this year, contains 10 to 1,000 times more microplastics than originally thought.
ex.t: 甚至瓶装水，科学家今年早些时候发现的，包含的微塑料比原先想象的多10到1000倍。

ex.s: With this in mind, perhaps we should judge a movie in its own right, and not against its original source.
ex.t: 考虑到这一点，也许我们应该独立判断一部电影，而不是根据其原始来源。

defs.def: a document, work of art, etc. produced for the first time, from which copies are later made 原件；正本；原稿；原作

ex.s: Many buildings on the campus are his original creations.
ex.t: 校园里的许多建筑都是他的原创作品。

ex.s: Soil surrounding the sequoia in its original location was relocated as well, because trees are more likely to survive a transplant when they move with their original soil.
ex.t: 红杉原址周围的土壤也一并迁移，因为带着原土移植，树更可能存活。

ex.s: One of the four original copies of the Magna Carta is displayed there.
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯是五列政府资助的医疗列车之一，行驶至俄罗斯中部和东部的偏远城镇。

ex.s: The Chinese characters “gōng” and “hé” together mean “work together, cooperate.” The original term — gõngyè  hézuòshè — means Chinese Industrial Cooperatives.
ex.t: 他印象深刻地说："……所有士兵都将自己致力于同一个理念，并共同努力实现这一理念。"然后他开始在海军陆战队中使用"工合"一词来试图创造他所见证的那种精神。

ex.s: The original iron boxes with the round roofs first appeared in 1926.
ex.t: 带有圆形屋顶的原始铁皮电话亭于1926年首次出现。

defs.def: a person who thinks, behaves, dresses, etc. in an unusual way （思想、行为、衣着等）不同寻常的人，独特的人，怪人

ex.s: Gong Bao Chicken (also known as Kung Pao Chicken) was originally a family dish of Ding Baozhen, or Ding Gongbao, a high-ranking court official of the Qing Dynasty who helped reconstruct the Dujiangyan Irrigation System in Chengdu, Sichuan.
ex.t: 宫保鸡丁（又名Kung Pao Chicken）原本是丁宝桢（又名丁宫保）的家常菜，他是清朝的一位高级官员，曾帮助重建四川成都的都江堰水利工程。

ex.s: Unlike the original stories, it is set in modern times and features modern technologies such as computers and smart phones.
ex.t: 与最初的故事不同，它以现代为背景，以电脑和智能手机等现代技术为特色。
